name: [😈] Killstreak Sword Fighting
desc:
⚔️ Welcome to Killstreak Sword Fighting! Fight your way to the top with edited versions of the linked sword, remade into cool weapons to get killstreaks. Use unique abilities, dominate the server, and prove yourself as the ultimate swordsman. 

🚨 Exploiting will get you PERMANENTLY banned. so DONT use executors... or else... 
🎶 I do not own any sounds/music in this game. For copyright concerns, feel free to DM me. 

😊 Thank YOU for playing :D

🎵 Music Credits: DM DOKURO, JJK, Derpcat, Yun Jedy (天亦海), PinpinNeon, Dutonic, Battlejuice, and YourAverageLoser. 
💡 Inspired by: Slap Battles, Sword Fight on the Heights, Killstreak Chaos, and more!
